narrative:
Athens County has 35,962 registered voters, with 13.4% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 13.3% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 58.7%, a pronounced Democratic lean of 45.4 percentage points. Gen Z are the largest generational cohort at 26.9% of registrants.
